verdicts.quote: whenever a seat of a `Full` class becomes free, the first `Waiting` entry is turned into a `Confirmed` booking for that member and its entry becomes `Promoted`

first-in-first-out by successful join … serialises all changes to that class (per-class ordering) … backend-assigned sequence … **Left out:** timed offer/claim windows; skipping an entry that conflicts in time with another booking; priority order other than join order
per-member limits and time-overlap across classes (default A-2: none) … skipping an entry that conflicts in time with another booking
verdicts.missing: The spec permits overlapping waitlists. It leaves open whether promotion in one class removes the member from the other waitlist or leaves them eligible for a second promotion.

verdicts.quote: a no-show (no no-show concept requested) … **Left out:** carrying the waitlist to the next occurrence of a recurring class; late-cancel penalties.
verdicts.missing: Automatic promotion removes the decline step. The spec does not say whether missing or cancelling the resulting booking incurs an existing penalty.

verdicts.quote: the member cancels their own booking through the existing cancel action … the backend frees the seat and promotes the first `Waiting` entry in one transactional unit … promotion completes synchronously with the cancel response

through the app's existing notification channel stating class and time and that they are now confirmed … dispatch failure never rolls back or delays the promotion; it is retried by the owning component
verdicts.missing: The delivery channel still needs to be identified. OG-4 leaves email, push and in-app delivery open.

verdicts.quote: k seats freed at once promote the first k entries in order … both orders: confirmed {cara, dan}, waitlist [eve] #1; 2 PROMOTED (cara, dan); confirmed ≤ 2 throughout

Nothing observable exists between release and promotion. … A `Full` class the member is already `Confirmed` in shows their booking; one the member is `Waitlisted` in shows their position (R-5), with no second offer.
if booking consumes credits, payments or a membership entitlement, how promotion handles insufficient entitlement. User decision. … promotion must not overbook or silently drop the entry
verdicts.missing: If a promoted booking requires payment, the charge time and the disposition of the seat and queue entry after payment failure remain open.

verdicts.quote: If a cap C exists, a join at length C is rejected `WAITLIST_FULL` with no change; value of C and whether it is per class are product decisions not in the request.
verdicts.missing: The accepted default is unlimited. The spec leaves adoption, size and scope of a cap open and gives only a rejection code for the member-facing outcome.

verdicts.quote: Close time is the existing booking cutoff (A-4), unresolved value OG-5. … seat freed at close time − 1 s promotes; at close time does not
verdicts.missing: The existing booking cutoff must be established to know whether, and how far before class start, promotion stops.

verdicts.quote: (c) capacity is raised *if the existing app can* (OG-9)
verdicts.missing: An increase can release seats for promotion. The spec leaves staff capacity controls unconfirmed and gives no rule for lowering capacity below the confirmed count while people are waiting.

verdicts.quote: when the studio cancels the class, every `Waiting` entry becomes `Expired`, joins are refused, and no promotion occurs afterwards … waitlisted members are notified "class cancelled" (one message each) in addition to expiry.
The waitlist entry holds: member id, class id, join sequence, join time, status. … Position is derived from the sequence at read time, not stored.
at close time, or when the studio cancels the class, every `Waiting` entry becomes `Expired` … terminal-entry retention matches the existing booking-record retention (period unresolved, OG-8)
verdicts.missing: The retention period for expired entries must be established from the existing booking-record policy.

verdicts.quote: `Waitlisted: #N` … the app shows no other member's identity, position or count of waitlisted people

staff removing members from a waitlist (OG-9) … Whether a staff view exists is OG-9. … Each promotion, expiry and notification failure is recorded with class id, member id, and promotion id, retrievable by operators
verdicts.missing: Manual removal is excluded. No staff permission or workflow is specified for inspecting the queue, promoting someone manually or viewing a timestamped promotion history.

verdicts.quote: Nothing observable exists between release and promotion. … promotion completes synchronously with the cancel response
booking an `Open` class, cancelling a booking, viewing bookings, authentication and class listings behave as before … existing booking reads and the capacity count are unchanged
applies exactly when confirmed == capacity before close time. … Unknown: whether any data migration is needed (OG-1/OG-7): the new entity is additive; existing rows are not changed
verdicts.missing: The full-class rule applies by occupancy. The spec leaves rollout mechanics open, including whether classes already full can accept a first join immediately or need initialization at deployment.
